title: Dynamics Among Borderline Personality and Anxiety Features in Psychotherapy Outpatients: An Exploration of Nomothetic and Idiographic Patterns
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited scope of symptoms measured; - Short data collection period (21 days); - Assumption of weak stationarity may not hold in active treatment; - Self-report measurement only.
notes: The study used GIMME, which is a novel method for person-specific modeling. The authors did not explicitly state whether they checked for redundancy between nodes. The code for GIMME is available on GitHub, but the specific code used in this study is not publicly available. The data is not publicly available.
